notes.title: Master of Mayhem got biggest update ever!
notes.content:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/576130
State of Anarchy project continues to grow! Long wait is over. Grab your weapons and prepare for a new wave of anarchy! DUAL WIELD UPDATE is finally released! This is the biggest update ever! It includes everything that is required to have some fun on the burning streets of Anarchy Town. Check out the list of new stuff!

All these features are available in [b]State of Anarchy: Master of Mayhem[/b].

[h1][b]Dual wield feature[/b][/h1]
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1247642989&fileuploadsuccess=1
What is the point to have two hands if you can hold only one gun? YES! Now you can carry two weapons and shoot from them by pressing Left or Right mouse button. Main guns have good range and accuracy - excellent choice for keeping enemies at bay. Special guns have shorter range but deal ~20% more damage which is a serious argument in close combat. It’s time to learn some new strategies on the battlefield!

[h1][b]New guns[/b][/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28254103/a72c6d7628489ecc1189141cce92e6d24d2f2c90.png[/img]
Arm dealing business is booming, there are tons of new guns in town! Grenade launchers, slime shooters, laser rifles, weird alien guns... There are so many new ways to wreak mayhem and destruction!

[h1][b]Random gun drops[/b][/h1]
Bosses in the most stages now drop different guns! Replay the levels if you want to try the whole arsenal!

[h1][b]Kick master talent[/b][/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28254103/a5d7dc68b1db4e12263a4d75cff0e38ec30648ba.png[/img]
Learn this talent to push back and damage enemies by touching them! It’s time to kick some ass!

[h1][b]Red enemies[/b][/h1]
These are tough fellas that need to be taken care of. They provide better loot and always drop a medkit.

[h1][b]New explosions[/b][/h1]
Destroyed cars and turrets now are shattered to pieces that damage and stun nearby enemies. Good for going out with a bang!

[h1][b]New special effects[/b][/h1]
Clouds, bullet marks and bloody splashes will make your eyes happy!

[h1][b]Balance tweaks[/b][/h1]
All medkits effectiveness was increased by 25%. Stay healthy!
Weapon upgrades price were dropped dramatically. It’s time to gear up!

[h1][b]Russian localization[/b][/h1]
And it’s only the beginning! Expect more languages soon…

We spend a lot of time to bring these cool features in the game! You can help us by [h1][b]writing reviews on Steam[/b][/h1] and spreading the word about this game! Let’s keep this wheel rolling, give us your support and we’ll bring even more new features in the game!
Anarchy never ends!

notes.title: ‘Master of Mayhem’ is coming!
notes.content:
Our new game [b]‘State of Anarchy: Master of Mayhem’[/b] will be released on 1 April 2017.

For the last three months our team was tuning and polishing it in order to roll out in the best possible quality.
‘Master of Mayhem’ includes all ‘State of Anarchy’ content and much more. Aliens are attacking the town! Your job is to repel the invasion, hit their homeworld and fight your way back to the Earth in a stolen spaceship. Be prepared for a long fight since the aliens won’t get it after the first try.
Core gameplay was refreshed and rebalanced. We’ve tweaked almost every mechanic in the game according to your feedback. Weapon now have a few modifications and can be upgraded. Car controls has been improved.
Game soundtrack was greatly expanded. Now it includes 23 tracks by Chatsky - musician who composed original SOA music.
‘Master of Mayhem’ is approximately 3 times bigger and longer than ‘State of Anarchy’. Also we plan to add new game+ feature to provide even longer experience.
Check the [url=https://youtu.be/9kR2fNL-PTo] gameplay trailer [/url] to see the changes.
[b]Join the fun![/b]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/576130/

notes.title: The latest from New Reality Games
notes.content:

This game is a great time killer and you're sure to have a fun and challenging experience whilst playing, 
Engaging the mind as well as entertaining it!

notes.title: State Of Anarchy Is Like Hand-Drawn Grand Theft Auto
notes.content:
If the original top-down Grand Theft Auto had been axed in its pre-production phase, someone had gathered its concept drawings from the cutting room floor, and had then painstakingly converted them into a flick book, then you might have something that sort-of resembles State of Anarchy [Steam page]. Although not quite as sophisticated as DMA Design’s 1997 original, its playful cartoon-styled take on bird’s-eye-view murder is great fun. What’s more, it’ll set you back less than a quid/euro/dollar.

… [visit site to read more]
